cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: What Really Happened?
cards.instruction: Find the truth by comparing details, repeating questions, and testing which parts of the story remain consistent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll approve the missing-parcel form once your description holds together. Bag or box? You've said both.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: May I put bag? I remember handles.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Permission withheld. Describe the handles: fabric or cardboard?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Cardboard, with a rigid lid below them. Could it be a box?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That revision is provisionally approved. Now account for 'bag'. Tell me what you carried again, starting with whether anything was around the box.
